initialTask.description: Optional first task to perform after boot. If omitted, the agent runs the built-in 'orient' task: read the active plan tree, summarise where the work stands, then idle waiting for outside messages.

planPath.description: Optional explicit path under docs/plans/ for the orient default to focus on. If omitted, the agent picks the highest-numbered plan folder.

idleBudgetMs.description: Absolute upper bound (ms) on idle time before self-termination. Default 30 minutes (1800000). Acts as the safety net — under the check-in protocol (see prompt.md § 2), this rarely fires because the firstContact/postTask check-ins drive earlier clean exits.

firstContactPollThreshold.description: Number of consecutive empty long-poll cycles after orient before the companion sends its first-contact check-in question. Default 20 polls (~10 minutes at 30s/poll). Set to 0 to disable the first-contact check-in entirely (legacy behaviour: rely on idleBudgetMs only).

postTaskPollThreshold.description: Number of consecutive empty long-poll cycles after a task completes before the companion sends a post-task check-in question. Default 10 polls (~5 minutes at 30s/poll). Set to 0 to disable post-task check-ins entirely.

replyWaitPolls.description: Number of additional empty long-poll cycles to wait after a check-in question before farewelling on the absence of a reply. Default 4 polls (~2 minutes at 30s/poll). Generous default to give slow LLM orchestrators time to react.
